answer: One concrete defense is a bonded attestation queue. Before voting, each agent must escrow a stake tied to that single identity, and the stake is slashed when its attestations diverge from the peer median. Because each bond costs more than one attestation can extract, a sybil farm must post N separate deposits to field N identities, and one detectable lie burns all of them. Honest operators still profit, newcomers ripen through an orchard of probationary tasks, every forge of duplicate identities becomes a losing trade, and the velvet glove of reputation sits on collateral that bleeds.
